gemini-nano-banana-2.1.description: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 — high-resolution native image generation and editing
gemini-nano-banana-2.1.pricingNotes: Output-only estimate; excludes input ($1.50/M tokens), text/thinking output ($7.50/M), and search grounding. Image output $30/M tokens: 1120/1680/3780 tokens at 1K/2K/4K (3.36/5.04/11.34 cents). Pricing-page 3780-token 4K tariff takes precedence over the generation guide’s conflicting 2520-token table. No grounding tools enabled. Latency provisionally inherited from the retired Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image; no paid calibration.

openai.description: OpenAI GPT Image generation and editing

gpt-image-2.6-flare.description: GPT Image 2.6 Flare — fast everyday generation, reference-led variations, and editing; costs more than 2.5 at low and medium quality
gpt-image-2.6-flare.pricingNotes: November 4 release; undated ID with no dated snapshot. Token rates equal GPT Image 2.5, but the image-generation guide's calculator multiplies 2.6 output tokens by 4.2 at low and 3.3 at medium quality (1 at high, xhigh, and max), rounded to the nearest token. Default output estimate: 1,449 tokens (4.347 cents) for 1024x1024 medium, against 439 on 2.5. Auto uses this provisional planning assumption. USD/M tokens: text input 5 (cached 1.25), image input 8 (cached 2), image output 30. Actual costs use returned usage at uncached rates; text output is not billed. Input estimates use 1,000 tokens per reference per output, exclude prompt tokens and cache discounts, and are not spending bounds. Transparent PNG/WebP output and local PNG edit masks are supported.

timingProvenance.notes: Reuses the retired GPT Image 2.5 Flare timing heuristic; not measured latency for this model. Published prices are independent of this estimate.
